title: feat(plugin-security)!: no seeder or materializer writes a sys_permission_set row; the boot seeds no row for a declared set (#15204 stage 6b-2)
body:
Part of #15204
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Stage **6b-2**: no seeder or materializer writes a `sys_permission_set` row, and the boot seeds no row for a declared set. The declared-permission seeder, the platform-default materialization, the `permission` publish materializer, the `metadata:reloaded` re-seed and the organization-creation hook are deleted, with drift, the seed refusal diagnostics and the `managed_by` normalizer ("only delete, never fix", batch #310 item 4). An uninstall still revokes every grant of the package's sets, now by name (option 1, the maintainer's ruling 6123311533; mechanism B, the seat's choice under option 1). Until stage 7 (7a, #22975) retires the ADR-0094 projector, a permission-set publish still has it write a transitional `admin` projection row (see "The ADR-0094 projector until stage 7" below). This PR leaves #15204 open: stages 7a, 7b, 8, 8-post, C7b and 6c remain.

## Landing — draft until the seat marks it ready

- **Prerequisites are on `main`**, last #22939 (grant-name pickers) and #22967 (the console pin), with CD (#22881) and 6b-2a (#22899) before them. `main` (`df7a137923`) is merged into this branch.
- **Then land back to back: T1 (#22897) → T2 (#22898) → this PR.** T1 and T2 stay drafts until then, so the seeders are never live on `main` with their pins gone. If `main` moves first, it is merged into all three again just before landing.
- **Size: Tier H.** Measured on its own once T1 and T2 are on `main` (simulated: `main` `df7a137923` + T1 `bb7b4cef36` + T2 `a38b54f6f2`, then this head): **3,601 changed lines** (48 files, +945 / −2,656). The uninstall revoke and its pins (mechanism B) took it over 3,000. This diff touches no governed path. Until T1 and T2 land, GitHub shows the whole branch.
- **Merge notes, for when `main` is merged in after T1 and T2:**
  - `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: regenerate with `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write` (measured: the regeneration produces no change against this branch).
  - The two `*.baseline.json` ledgers: T1 and T2 conflict with each other there; drop every entry for a deleted suite.

## What changes

| Surface | Before | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `bootstrap-declared-permissions.ts` (522 lines) | seeded every declared set as a `managed_by:'package'` row, once per organization under a wall | deleted |
| `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` | seeded the platform defaults insert-once; `resync` reconciled them | writes no catalog row. It reads the legacy `admin_full_access` row only for leg C (a grant written before the name column; restrict-only). A refused read withholds the promotion and says so once. No `resync` option, no `seeded` / `resynced` / `resyncSkipped` |
| `permission` publish materializer (SP) | upserted a package-door publish into a row; ran the suggestion reconcile and `everyone`'s re-derivation only when it materialized and the body carried `isDefault` | deleted. The reconcile and the re-derivation hang off `onMetadataMutation`: every landed `permission` publish, direct save or delete, unconditionally. Drafts and other types do nothing (closes U2 contract flag A, 6109964380). The ADR-0094 projector still writes an `admin` projection row on the publish until stage 7 (next section) |
| `metadata:reloaded` re-seed, organization-creation hook (SP) | re-seeded rows after a hot install and per new organization | deleted |
| `permission-set-drift.ts`, `normalize-managed-by.ts`, `seed-refusal-diagnostics.ts` | boot diagnostics over the seeded rows | deleted; their public exports go (listed in the changeset) |
| `warnOrganizationLessRows`, `catalogIsPerOrganization`, `listSeedOrganizationIds` (`organization-scope.ts`, internal) | the per-organization sweep and the organization-less row guard; the seeder was their one caller | deleted (re-measured: no live caller, no test) |
| `sys_permission_set.drift_status` / `drift_detail` and the **Needs Attention** view | written by drift | removed with their writer (translations regenerated). The packaged-overlay report still names a shadowed set at boot |
| `readDeclared` | exported by the seeder | re-homed into `declared-capability-context.ts` (its two readers: the capability context and the managed-object write denies). It is a read of the registry, the catalog's one home, never of a row |
| **Uninstall** (`security.package-permissions`, both doors) | found a package's grants through its `managed_by:'package'` rows | see the next section |

## The ADR-0094 projector until stage 7 (measured)

With the `permission` materializer gone, the awaited ADR-0094 projector (`projectPermissionMutation`, retired in stage 7 / 7a #22975) is the one writer left on a publish. Measured on the CRM stack, fresh database, this head against `main`:

| | this PR | `main` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| package-door publish (draft, then `publishPackageDrafts`) | 1 row: `managed_by:'admin'`, no `package_id` | 1 row: `managed_by:'package'`, `package_id` |
| writable base's direct `saveMetaItem` publish | 1 row: `admin`, no `package_id` | the same (pre-existing) |
| admin data-door `PATCH` | accepted; written through into the base's own `sys_metadata` row (no environment overlay); the catalog serves the edit | the same |
| admin data-door `DELETE` | deletes the row, the base's `sys_metadata` row and the served set | answers `success:false`; the row stays, the `sys_metadata` row goes |
| `deletePackage` | the row is removed (the projector's delete leg) | the row is removed |
| boot with a base-published set and no row (file-backed DB, re-boot) | the boot reconcile re-creates one `admin` row | not measured |

No authorization path reads the row (the resolver reads set bodies from the catalog). The one change from `main` is the provenance of a package-door publish's row (`package` → `admin`) and what a data-door delete of it does. Stage-plan rule: `permission-set-projection.ts` retires in 7a, so it is not fixed here ("only delete, never fix"). The seat carries "after 7a, a package-door publish writes no row" on 7a's card. The alternative, a projector guard that creates no row for a package-held name, is offered to the maintainer as (A).

## Uninstall: the grants naming the package's sets (ADR-0090 D5)

With no row standing for a package's set, the cleanup found no grant to revoke: a grant naming the set survived the uninstall, inert while nothing served the name, and **live again on reinstall**. Option 1 (the maintainer's ruling on #15204, 6123311533): revoke by the package's catalog set names, read before the package is withdrawn. Mechanism B (the seat's choice under option 1): capture before the withdrawal and hand the names to the cleanups; the lifecycle order is untouched.

- **One capture, both doors, the same point.** `captureUninstallDeclared(registry, packageId, stored?)` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`) runs just before `registry.uninstallPackage`, in `deletePackage` and in install-local's `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:id`. The withdrawal still precedes the cleanups (#21576 / #21490 race guard unchanged); the capture is synchronous, so install-local still has no `await` between the ledger removal and the withdrawal.
- **Two sources, unioned:**
  - the registry: `SchemaRegistry.securityCatalogNamesHeldBy(packageId, 'permission')` (new; the package's claims and `<packageId>:<name>` item slots, unfiltered by disable, since a disabled package still holds its names). This names an installed (artifact / install-local) package's sets.
  - on `deletePackage`, the `permission` rows of the package's `sys_metadata` that the door already read before any delete. **A base-authored item is held in the registry's bare slot with no `_packageId` (provenance `org`)** (measured on the CRM stack: `securityCatalogNamesHeldBy(base)` answers `[]`, while `sys_metadata` holds `{ type: 'permission', name }`), so the registry alone cannot attribute it to the base.
- **The hand-off is additive and optional:** `UninstallCleanup`'s args gain `declared?: { permission?: string[] }`, passed by `runUninstallCleanups` only when the capture named a set. A package that declared none hands its cleanups exactly the request they had before. `PACKAGE_JOBS_UNINSTALL_CLEANUP` is unchanged.
- **The cleanup** revokes every `sys_user_permission_set` grant naming a captured set. A name has one holder (the registry refuses a second at install), so each such grant was a grant of this package's set.
- **The legacy row path stays:** an already-seeded database keeps its `managed_by:'package'` rows until C7b (this PR's changeset says so). Grants written before the name column and `sys_position_permission_set` bindings (which carry only `permission_set_id`, no name column) are still reached through such a row.
- **Not touched:** a position declared in the catalog that lists the uninstalled package's set is metadata an author wrote, not a grant row; it stays as authored.

## Pins

- `builtin-positions.boot.test.ts` (real plugin boot, real SQLite, every scenario): **zero `sys_permission_set` rows** after boot, with a positive census control. The first platform administrator (`single`) and the organization administrator are still granted. The grant golden is unchanged, with no row at all.
- `grant-permission-set-name.writers.test.ts`: the promotion leaves zero rows and the holder reads by name. The 6b-2-pre pins stay green.
- `everyone-rederivation-on-permission-mutation.test.ts`: one listener even across a bootstrap re-run. Publish and delete of a `permission` re-derive; a draft or another type does not.
- `showcase-permission-seeding.dogfood.test.ts` (the `declarative-permission-seeding` authz row, rewritten): the showcase's sets are served by the catalog with their package, and the boot writes no row.
- `bootstrap-platform-admin-refused-existence-read.test.ts`: a refused legacy read withholds the promotion and writes nothing.
- **Uninstall, each source with its own ablation:**
  - **registry-held source (install-local door).** `marketplace-install-local-uninstall-withdrawal.test.ts`: the order is capture → withdraw → cleanups, and the cleanups get the names; control: a registry that cannot say hands nothing. End to end, `package-install-local-uninstall-cleanups.integration.test.ts` (CLI, four orders of events, rewritten to the catalog): grant by name → DELETE → the grant is gone → after a restart, another package's hot install, and a **reinstall of the same package**, the grant is not live again ("the grant revoked by the DELETE does not come back with the set"). Ablation: the capture answering nothing turned the door pin red (1 of 8); the controls stayed green.
  - **base-authored source (`deletePackage` door).** `package-uninstall-revokes-named-grants.dogfood.test.ts` (CRM stack): a writable base publishes a set, a user is granted it by name, `deletePackage` → the grant is gone; the base publishes the set again → it is served, and the grant does not come back. Ablation: dropping the capture in `deletePackage` turned 2 of 3 red. Before the stored-row source existed, this pin was red with the registry-only capture.
  - `protocol.uninstall-declared-capture.test.ts`: the helper (both sources, the union, nothing when nothing names a set), the runner's hand-off, and `deletePackage`'s order. `protocol.uninstall-cleanups-runner.test.ts`'s control (a request with no capture is passed through unchanged) stays green.
  - `registry-security-catalog-names-held-by.test.ts`: the names a package holds, a disabled package included, none after uninstall.
  - `cleanup-package-permissions.test.ts`: the named grants go, with a no-names control in which they survive.

## Tests this branch rewrites (they pinned the rows it removes)

- `standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts` (runtime): asserts no row for a declared set, as it already did for a capability.
- `package-install-local-boot-steps.integration.test.ts` (CLI, #21322): the hot-installed set is read from `GET /meta/permission/…`. The flow cases still pin #21322's defect; the permission-set case now pins the current contract (the catalog served the set before #21322 too).

## Also in this PR

- **Liveness ledger.** `permission.packageId` re-points to its surviving reader (the CLI's compile-time collision door). `permission.managedBy` is corrected to `dead` (see Acceptance notes).
- **Tenant-audit census** regenerated after merging `main`: `main` has 227 write sites, and this branch's removal of the normalizer's and the platform-admin bootstrap's `update` sites takes it to **225**. The hand-written figures on `tenant-audit-census.mdx` follow.
- **Docs**: `permission-sets.mdx` (built-in sets, provenance, the drift section reduced to overlay shadow) and `authorization.mdx`.
- **Gate ledgers**: the double-contract ledgers drop the retired suites and pin the new one.

## Changeset

One file, `.changeset/15204-s6b2-declared-permission-seeders.md`:
- `@objectstack/plugin-security` **minor**, BREAKING, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The level is unchanged by the uninstall work: nothing an author writes moves.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` **minor** and `@objectstack/objectql` **minor**, additive: the optional `declared` argument of the exported `UninstallCleanup` type and of `runUninstallCleanups`' request, the `UninstallDeclared` type, `captureUninstallDeclared`, and `SchemaRegistry.securityCatalogNamesHeldBy`. `@objectstack/cloud-connection` **patch** (its door hands the names on). `cleanupPackagePermissions` takes an optional fourth argument.
- `check:changeset-no-major` and `check:adr-0087-registration` exit 0.

## Verification (local, at this head)

At `ecfb54f8b8`, `main` `df7a137923` merged in (`c60e08810`). The merge had two conflicts: install-local's imports, where both sides' imports were kept, and the declaration-copy test's persisted-row case, which #22994 had rewritten and which keeps this branch's "no row" side.

- Build: `turbo run build`, every task green. Typecheck green for the 21 packages below and dogfood.
- Suites (`turbo run test`, 21 packages: plugin-security, platform-objects, runtime, metadata-protocol, cli (unit and integration), objectql, cloud-connection, plugin-auth, organizations, plugin-approvals, plugin-sharing, mcp, rest, hono, client, http-conformance, core, example-crm, example-showcase, example-todo, example-multi-package): **82 of 82 tasks green**. plugin-auth: 136 files, 2,780 passed. cloud-connection: 43 files, 519 passed (from source; see below).
- Dogfood, **in full**: 258 files passed, 1 skipped; 2,117 tests passed, 9 skipped (the `deletePackage` door pin, the grant-name pickers and `main`'s walled-catalog suites included).
- The rewritten suites (before this merge, on a fresh full build): (a) runtime 13/13; (b) cli boot-steps 7/7; (c) cli uninstall-cleanups 17/17. All three are inside the suite run above.
- `check-i18n-bundles`: green after the full build.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 117 derived families, all run and reconciled by `--ran`, 0 not measured.
  - `check:test-source-alias` went red on this diff earlier (cloud-connection's new runtime import of `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`). It is now aliased to source and green.
  - `check-engine-split-ratio` needs history covering its 90-day window; the clone was deepened to it, exit 0.
  - The one non-zero: `check:platform-checklist`, the same 8 absent-symbol anchors on T1 (which touches no checklist file). That check is the scheduled watchdog's (`checklist-status.yml`), not a per-PR gate, and `main`'s checklist cites none of T1's deleted files.
- `check:changeset-no-major` and `check:adr-0087-registration`: exit 0. `check-tenant-audit-census`: OK, 225 sites.

After `ecfb54f8b8`, three text rounds from the contract reviews: `5cc2ef8629`, `70a42bf2f5` and `320ce20b74`. They change docs prose, code comments, the changeset's wording, two `sys_permission_set` field descriptions (with the English translation bundle regenerated) and two install-local warn strings; no code path. At `320ce20b74`:
- plugin-security: 191 files, 3,973 passed;
- cloud-connection: 44 files, 538 passed;
- the protocol capture pins: 10/10;
- `check-i18n-bundles`, the docs checks, `check:changeset-no-major` and `check:adr-0087-registration`: all 0;
- `dispatch-gates`: 119/119 run, the only non-zero being the checklist watchdog.

## Acceptance notes

- **Data-door reach on a package-door-published set** (a writable base, package installed; measured on the CRM stack, this PR vs `main`):
  - a data-door `PATCH` is 200 on both and lands in the base's own `sys_metadata` row, with no environment overlay;
  - a data-door `DELETE` deletes end to end here (the row, the `sys_metadata` row and the catalog entry), while `main` half-applies it (`success:false`; `sys_metadata` gone, the row and the served body kept);
  - a grant naming the deleted set stays and goes dead, and is live again if the base republishes that name, as it would be on `main` after a reload;
  - under `single` the wall is inert, so the door is open to any caller with CRUD on `sys_permission_set` (the platform operator in practice); under `group` / `isolated` the wall refuses everyone but the operator (ADR-0131 D3);
  - the provenance key: the row's `managed_by:'package'` is what the projector's delete leg, the data-layer gate's `transfer` / `restore` / `purge` refusals and the uninstall cleanup's legacy row path key on, and a publish no longer stamps it here. The packaged-set lock (`packaged-permission-set-lock.ts`) keys on the artifact, not the row, and answers the same on both trees (delta review 6130075012 ①8);
  - carrier: 7a retires the projector and both write-throughs (#22975, seat note 6129253247).

- **Stale text left to its carriers:** `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:845` (`managedBy`'s JSDoc, "seeded by `bootstrapDeclaredPermissions`, re-seeded on upgrade"): the spec seat, with the `managedBy` enforce-or-remove item. `seed-name-lookup.ts:9` and `packages/objectql/src/engine-capability-provenance.test.ts:164–165` (comments): C7b.

- **`permission.managedBy` is an authored key with no reader** (pre-existing; the ledger now says `dead`). Retiring it is an enforce-or-remove item for the spec seat. It is not done here.
- **The name-fold census instrument** (`scripts/measure-position-name-fold-census.mjs`, not a CI gate) refuses to report since 6b-2a deleted the binders. Carrier: whoever next runs it re-aims its junction scan at `PositionSchema.permissionSets`.
- **Two dogfood suites** (`two-doors-permission`, `showcase-permission-projection`) keep their data-door cases on an existing database (the fixture writes the legacy row), because the gate still guards such rows until 7a / stage 8.
- **plugin-auth's two grant-reader suites** read the legacy platform-bucket rows; their fixture is T2's item (d) (#22898, `a38b54f6f`), carried here byte-identical (`8e40fb06b`) as this branch carries T2's other bytes, so it cancels out of the measured size.

## 维护者速读（草稿）

**改了什么**：不再有任何播种器或物化器向 `sys_permission_set` 表写行，启动时也不再为声明的权限集播种行（在阶段 7 删除 ADR-0094 投影器之前，发布权限集时投影器仍会写一条 `admin` 投影行，鉴权不读它，卸载包时会被删掉）。删除了：包声明权限集的播种器、平台默认权限集的物化、包发布时的物化器、热安装后的重播种、新建组织时的播种，以及基于这些行的漂移诊断、`managed_by` 归一化和播种拒绝诊断。`drift_status`/`drift_detail` 两个字段及「需要关注」视图随写入者一并删除。卸载包时仍会撤销所有指向该包权限集的授权：两个卸载入口在把包从注册表撤下之前，先记下该包持有的权限集名称（注册表中的名称，加上 `deletePackage` 已读到的该包已存储的权限集行），交给清理步骤按名称撤销授权（方案 1 是你的裁定 6123311533；机制 B 是席位在方案 1 之下的选择）。

**为什么改**：ADR-0131 D3 规定权限集只有一个家——注册表。鉴权解析器早已从注册表读定义，授权按名称写入，这些行已不再决定任何权限。卸载按名称撤销，是为了守住 ADR-0090 D5「不留幽灵授权」：否则授权会在卸载后残留，并在重新安装后重新生效。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：已有数据库保留旧行（直到 C7b），旧行路径的撤销照旧。删除了若干公开导出和 `bootstrapPlatformAdmin` 的 `resync` 选项，changeset 已逐项列出；新增的卸载交接字段是可选的，不读它的清理步骤行为不变。本 PR 单独计 3,601 行（超过 3,000），因此为 Tier H。回滚：直接 revert，无数据迁移。

**席位意见**：

**你要做的**：T1、T2、本 PR 依次合并；本 PR 因体量为 Tier H，需要你批准。
